Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: Relied on a search-engine snippet claiming IMDb listed “Copenhagen” as Anne Gadegaard’s birthplace without opening and verifying the source. This introduced an incorrect/conflicting datum (her birthplace is Aarhus/Århus, Denmark) and derailed the process. Subsequent steps kept repeating searches without properly consulting and citing credible pages, preventing a correct resolution.
